input: I want a refund for an order I placed 40 days ago.

expected.answer: Our refund window is 30 days, so an order placed 40 days ago is outside it; I can offer store credit instead.

input: I can't log in and the reset email never arrives.

expected.answer: I've triggered a fresh password-reset email and confirmed it went to your address; please also check spam.

input: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday but it hasn't.

expected.answer: Your package is delayed in transit and now expected within two business days; here is the updated tracking.

input: Please cancel my subscription, I no longer need it.

expected.answer: I've cancelled your subscription effective at the end of the current billing period; you won't be charged again.

input: The item I received is broken and I want a replacement.

expected.answer: I'm sorry the item arrived broken; I've started a free replacement and emailed you a prepaid return label.
